decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n const size_t n) {\\n    // A is stored in row-major order\\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\\n            double sum = 0.0;\\n            \\n            if (i == j) {\\n                // Diagonal element\\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\\n                }\\n B^T\\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\\n            double sum = 0.0;\\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\\n            }\\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\\n        }\\n    }\\n    \\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and {\\n            double sum = 0.0;\\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\\n            }\\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\\n        }\\n    }\\n    \\n    // Compare with original\\n    double maxError = 0.0;\\n    double relError = 0.0;\\n    \\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\\n        \\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\\n    }\\n    \\n    printf(\\\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\\\n\\\", maxError);\\n    printf(\\\"Max relative error: %.10e\\\\n\\\", relError);\\n    \\n    // Check if error is within {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CefG3YXfSpREN3xa2Zbss","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EMREE1cqNTwFk8Mi3zsDpb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/cholesky_claude-fable-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r1/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cublas_v2.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition (right-looking blocked\n// algorithm). Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is\n// lower triangular.\n//\n// Parallelization layout:\n//  - MPI: block rows of the matrix are distributed 1D block-cyclically over\n//    the ranks; each rank drives one GPU (rank % deviceCount).\n//  - CUDA/cuBLAS: panel TRSM and trailing-matrix GEMM updates (the O(n^3)\n//    bulk of the work), as well as matrix generation and validation GEMMs.\n//  - OpenMP: host-side diagonal block factorization, panel packing/unpacking,\n//    result assembly and validation comparison.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define CUBLAS_CHECK(call)                                                    \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cublasStatus_t st_ = (call);                                          \\\n        if (st_ != CUBLAS_STATUS_SUCCESS) {                                   \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"cuBLAS error %d at %s:%d\\n\", (int)st_, __FILE__, \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr size_t kBlock = 256; // block size for the blocked factorization\n\nint g_rank = 0;\nint g_nprocs = 1;\ncublasHandle_t g_cublas;\n\ninline size_t numBlocks(size_t n) { return (n + kBlock - 1) / kBlock; }\ninline int ownerOf(size_t blk) { return (int)(blk % (size_t)g_nprocs); }\ninline size_t blockSize(size_t blk, size_t n, size_t nb) {\n    return (blk == nb - 1) ? n - blk * kBlock : kBlock;\n}\n// Row offset of global block `blk` inside its owner's local storage. All\n// blocks except the global last one have kBlock rows, so this is exact.\ninline size_t localRowOffset(size_t blk) { return (blk / (size_t)g_nprocs) * kBlock; }\n\n// Add `val` to the diagonal entries of a block row stored on the device.\n// rowBlock points at the first row of the block; the diagonal entries of the\n// block sit at column colStart + r for local row r.\n__global__ void addDiagKernel(double* rowBlock, size_t n, size_t colStart, int bs,\n                              double val) {\n    int r = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r < bs) {\n        rowBlock[(size_t)r * n + colStart + r] += val;\n    }\n}\n\n// Host Cholesky factorization of an m x m row-major block (lower triangle).\n// Returns -1 on success or the index of the offending diagonal element.\nint hostPotrf(double* A, int m, int ld) {\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        double d = A[(size_t)j * ld + j];\n        for (int t = 0; t < j; ++t) {\n            d -= A[(size_t)j * ld + t] * A[(size_t)j * ld + t];\n        }\n        if (d <= 0.0) {\n            return j;\n        }\n        d = sqrt(d);\n        A[(size_t)j * ld + j] = d;\n        const double inv = 1.0 / d;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (m - j > 64)\n        for (int i = j + 1; i < m; ++i) {\n            double s = A[(size_t)i * ld + j];\n            for (int t = 0; t < j; ++t) {\n                s -= A[(size_t)i * ld + t] * A[(size_t)j * ld + t];\n            }\n            A[(size_t)i * ld + j] = s * inv;\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Number of matrix rows owned by rank r.\nsize_t localRows(int r, size_t n, size_t nb) {\n    size_t rows = 0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)r; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        rows += blockSize(i, n, nb);\n    }\n    return rows;\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\n// Distributed generation of the symmetric positive definite matrix\n// A = B * B^T + n * I. Every rank generates the identical random B (cheap,\n// O(n^2)) and computes its own block rows of A on its GPU. The local block\n// rows are left in dLocal (row-major, leading dimension n).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* dLocal, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    // Sequential PRNG stream, identical on every rank (matches the reference\n    // generator exactly).\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const double one = 1.0, zero = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)g_rank; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        const size_t bs = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n        double* dRows = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n;\n        // Row-major: A_rows = B_rows * B^T. k < nb && ok; ++k) {\n        const size_t bk = blockSize(k, n, nb);\n        const int owner = ownerOf(k);\n\n        // 1) Factorize the diagonal block on the owner's CPU (OpenMP).\n        int status = -1;\n        if (g_rank == owner) {\n            double* dDiag = dLocal + localRowOffset(k) * n + k * kBlock;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(hLkk, bk * sizeof(double), dDiag, n * sizeof(double),\n                                    bk * sizeof(double), bk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            status = hostPotrf(hLkk, (int)bk, (int)bk);\n            if (status >= 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                       k * kBlock + (size_t)status);\n                fflush(stdout);\n            } else {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(dDiag, n * sizeof(double), hLkk,\n                                        bk * sizeof(double), bk * sizeof(double), bk,\n                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            ok = false;\n            break;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(hLkk, (int)(bk * bk), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (k + 1 == nb) {\n            break; <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is\n// lower triangular.\n//\n// Parallelization layout:\n//  - MPI: block rows of the matrix are distributed 1D block-cyclically over\n//    the ranks; each rank drives one GPU (rank % deviceCount).\n//  - CUDA/cuBLAS: panel TRSM and trailing-matrix GEMM updates (the O(n^3)\n//    bulk of the work), as well as matrix generation and validation GEMMs.\n//  - OpenMP: host-side diagonal block factorization, panel packing/unpacking,\n//    result assembly and validation comparison.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define CUBLAS_CHECK(call)                                                    \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cublasStatus_t st_ = (call);                                          \\\n        if (st_ != CUBLAS_STATUS_SUCCESS) {                                   \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"cuBLAS error %d at %s:%d\\n\", (int)st_, __FILE__, \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr size_t kBlock = 256; // block size for the blocked factorization\n\nint g_rank = 0;\nint g_nprocs = 1;\ncublasHandle_t g_cublas;\n\ninline size_t numBlocks(size_t n) { return (n + kBlock - 1) / kBlock; }\ninline int ownerOf(size_t blk) { return (int)(blk % (size_t)g_nprocs); }\ninline size_t blockSize(size_t blk, size_t n, size_t nb) {\n    return (blk == nb - 1) ? n - blk * kBlock : kBlock;\n}\n// Row offset of global block `blk` inside its owner's local storage. All\n// blocks except the global last one have kBlock rows, so this is exact.\ninline size_t localRowOffset(size_t blk) { return (blk / (size_t)g_nprocs) * kBlock; }\n\n// Add `val` to the diagonal entries of a block row stored on the device.\n// rowBlock points at the first row of the block; the diagonal entries of the\n// block sit at column colStart + r for local row r.\n__global__ void addDiagKernel(double* rowBlock, size_t n, size_t colStart, int bs,\n                              double val) {\n    int r = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r < bs) {\n        rowBlock[(size_t)r * n + colStart + r] += val;\n    }\n}\n\n// Host Cholesky factorization of an m x m row-major block (lower triangle).\n// Returns -1 on success or the index of the offending diagonal element.\nint hostPotrf(double* A, int m, int ld) {\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        double d = A[(size_t)j * ld + j];\n        for (int t = 0; t < j; ++t) {\n            d -= A[(size_t)j * ld + t] * A[(size_t)j * ld + t];\n        }\n        if (d <= 0.0) {\n            return j;\n        }\n        d = sqrt(d);\n        A[(size_t)j * ld + j] = d;\n        const double inv = 1.0 / d;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (m - j > 64)\n        for (int i = j + 1; i < m; ++i) {\n            double s = A[(size_t)i * ld + j];\n            for (int t = 0; t < j; ++t) {\n                s -= A[(size_t)i * ld + t] * A[(size_t)j * ld + t];\n            }\n            A[(size_t)i * ld + j] = s * inv;\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Number of matrix rows owned by rank r.\nsize_t localRows(int r, size_t n, size_t nb) {\n    size_t rows = 0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)r; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        rows += blockSize(i, n, nb);\n    }\n    return rows;\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\n// Distributed generation of the symmetric positive definite matrix\n// A = B * B^T + n * I. Every rank generates the identical random B (cheap,\n// O(n^2)) and computes its own block rows of A on its GPU. The local block\n// rows are left in dLocal (row-major, leading dimension n).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* dLocal, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    // Sequential PRNG stream, identical on every rank (matches the reference\n    // generator exactly).\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const double one = 1.0, zero = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)g_rank; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        const size_t bs = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n        double* dRows = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n;\n        // Row-major: A_rows = B_rows * B^T. The local block\n// rows are left in dLocal (row-major, leading dimension n).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* dLocal, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    // Sequential PRNG stream, identical on every rank (matches the reference\n    // generator exactly).\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const double one = 1.0, zero = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)g_rank; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        const size_t bs = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n        double* dRows = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n;\n        // Row-major: A_rows = B_rows * B^T. Returns true on success; on failure the owner rank prints\n// the offending diagonal element (matching the reference implementation).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* dLocal, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    double *dLkk = nullptr, *dPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLkk, kBlock * kBlock * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPanel, (n + kBlock) * kBlock * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double *hLkk = nullptr, *hGath = nullptr, *hPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hLkk, kBlock * kBlock * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hGath, (n + kBlock) * kBlock * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanel, (n + kBlock) * kBlock * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<int> sendCounts(g_nprocs), displs(g_nprocs);\n    const double one = 1.0, minusOne = -1.0;\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nb && ok; ++k) {\n        const size_t bk = blockSize(k, n, nb);\n        const int owner = ownerOf(k);\n\n        // 1) Factorize the diagonal block on the owner's CPU (OpenMP).\n        int status = -1;\n        if (g_rank == owner) {\n            double* dDiag = dLocal + localRowOffset(k) * n + k * kBlock;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(hLkk, bk * sizeof(double), dDiag, n * sizeof(double),\n                                    bk * sizeof(double), bk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            status = hostPotrf(hLkk, (int)bk, (int)bk);\n            if (status >= 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                       k * kBlock + (size_t)status);\n                fflush(stdout);\n            } else {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(dDiag, n * sizeof(double), hLkk,\n                                        bk * sizeof(double), bk * sizeof(double), bk,\n                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            ok = false;\n            break;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(hLkk, (int)(bk * bk), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (k + 1 == nb) {\n            break; i < nb; ++i) {\n            if (ownerOf(i) != g_rank) continue;\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            double* dAik = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + k * kBlock;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(g_cublas, CUBLAS_SIDE_LEFT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_UPPER,\n                                     CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, (int)bk, (int)bi,\n                                     &one, dLkk, (int)bk, dAik, (int)n));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n        // 3) Assemble the panel column k in global i order on every device.\n        // Owned blocks are copied device-to-device (strided -> contiguous);\n        // blocks from other ranks are exchanged via an MPI allgather, with\n        // each rank contributing its owned blocks in increasing i order.\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_nprocs; ++r) sendCounts[r] = 0;\n        // Offset of block i within its owner's allgather segment (srcOff) and\n        // within the assembled i-ordered panel (dstOff).\n        std::vector<size_t> srcOff(nb - k - 1), dstOff(nb - k - 1);\n        size_t panelOff = 0;\n        for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            srcOff[i - k - 1] = (size_t)sendCounts[ownerOf(i)];\n            dstOff[i - k - 1] = panelOff;\n            sendCounts[ownerOf(i)] += (int)(bi * bk);\n            panelOff += bi * bk;\n        }\n        displs[0] = 0;\n        for (int r = 1; r < g_nprocs; ++r) displs[r] = displs[r - 1] + sendCounts[r - 1];\n\n        for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            if (ownerOf(i) != g_rank) continue;\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dPanel + dstOff[i - k - 1], bk * sizeof(double),\n                                         dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + k * kBlock,\n                                         n * sizeof(double), bk * sizeof(double), bi,\n                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));\n        }\n        if (g_nprocs > 1) {\n            for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n                const int r = ownerOf(i);\n                if (r == g_rank) continue;\n                const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPanel + dstOff[i - k - 1],\n                                           hGath + displs[r] + srcOff[i - k - 1],\n                                           bi * bk * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 4) Trailing-matrix update on the GPU: for each owned row i > k,\n        // A_i,(k+1..i) -= L_ik * Panel(k+1..i)^T. In column-major terms:\n        // C^T (w x bi) += -Panel (w x bk) * L_ik^T (bk x bi).\n        for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            if (ownerOf(i) != g_rank) continue;\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            const size_t w = std::min((i + 1) * kBlock, n) - (k + 1) * kBlock;\n            double* dLik = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + k * kBlock;\n            double* dC = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + (k + 1) * kBlock;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(g_cublas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)w, (int)bi,\n                                     (int)bk, &minusOne, dPanel, (int)bk, dLik, (int)n,\n                                     &one, dC, (int)n));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hGath));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hLkk));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dLkk));\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Distributed validation: L is broadcast to all ranks, each rank reconstructs\n// its block rows of L * L^T on its GPU and compares them against its saved\n// original rows with OpenMP; the error maxima are reduced over MPI.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const double* hOrigLocal,\n                      const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    double* dL = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* hChunk = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hChunk, kBlock * n * sizeof(double)));\n    for (size_t MPI_Bcast(hChunk, (int)(bs * n), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL + i * kBlock * n, hChunk, bs * n * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    double* dRecon = nullptr;\n    double* hRecon = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRecon, kBlock * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hRecon, kBlock * n * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    const double one = 1.0, zero = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)g_rank; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        const size_t bs = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n        // Row-major: recon_rows = L_rows(i) * L^T, i.e. column-major\n        // recon^T (n x bs) = L (n x n) * L_rows^T (n x bs).\n        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(g_cublas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)n, (int)bs,\n                                 (int)n, &one, dL, (int)n, dL + i * kBlock * n, (int)n,\n                                 &zero, dRecon, (int)n));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hRecon, dRecon, bs * n * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        const double* orig = hOrigLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n        for (size_t e = 0; e < bs * n; ++e) {\n            const double error = fabs(hRecon[e] - orig[e]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            relError = std::max(relError, error / (fabs(orig[e]) + 1e-10));\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hRecon));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hChunk));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dRecon));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: i < nb; ++i) {\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            srcOff[i - k - 1] = (size_t)sendCounts[ownerOf(i)];\n            dstOff[i - k - 1] = panelOff;\n            sendCounts[ownerOf(i)] += (int)(bi * bk);\n            panelOff += bi * bk;\n        }\n        displs[0] = 0;\n        for (int r = 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n                const int r = ownerOf(i);\n                if (r == g_rank) continue;\n                const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPanel + dstOff[i - k - 1],\n                                           hGath + displs[r] + srcOff[i - k - 1],\n                                           bi * bk * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 4) Trailing-matrix update on the GPU: for each owned row i > k,\n        // A_i,(k+1..i) -= L_ik * Panel(k+1..i)^T. In column-major terms:\n        // C^T (w x bi) += -Panel (w x bk) * L_ik^T (bk x bi).\n        for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            if (ownerOf(i) != g_rank) continue;\n            const size_t bi = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n            const size_t w = std::min((i + 1) * kBlock, n) - (k + 1) * kBlock;\n            double* dLik = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + k * kBlock;\n            double* dC = dLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n + (k + 1) * kBlock;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(g_cublas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)w, (int)bi,\n                                     (int)bk, &minusOne, dPanel, (int)bk, dLik, (int)n,\n                                     &one, dC, (int)n));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hGath));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hLkk));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dLkk));\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Distributed validation: L is validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const double* hOrigLocal,\n                      const size_t n) {\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n);\n\n    double* dL = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* hChunk = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hChunk, kBlock * n * sizeof(double)));\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; ++i) {\n n), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL + i * kBlock * n, hChunk, bs * n * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    double* maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    const double one = 1.0, zero = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)g_rank; i < nb; i += (size_t)g_nprocs) {\n        const size_t bs = blockSize(i, n, nb);\n        // Row-major: recon_rows = L_rows(i) * L^T, i.e. column-major\n        // recon^T (n x bs) = L (n x n) * L_rows^T (n x bs).\n        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(g_cublas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hRecon, dRecon, bs * n * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        const double* orig = hOrigLocal + localRowOffset(i) * n;\n#pragma omp std::max(maxError, error);\n            relError = std::max(relError, error / (fabs(orig[e]) + 1e-10));\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hRecon));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hChunk));\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CefH7JdE1HVtf8PUfgJhB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The cholesky benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation, verified correct and scaling to ~870 GFLOPS on 4 GPUs versus ~1.5 GFLOPS for the original sequential code (roughly 500× at n=16384).\n\n**Design** (all in the existing `cholesky/cholesky.cpp`, executable name unchanged):\n- **Algorithm:** right-looking blocked Cholesky (block size 256; I benchmarked 512 and it was slightly slower). Block rows are distributed 1D block-cyclically over **MPI** ranks, each rank driving one GPU (`rank % deviceCount`).\n- **CUDA/cuBLAS** does all the O(n³) work: the panel TRSM and trailing-matrix GEMM updates each step, plus the matrix generation (A = B·Bᵀ + n·I, also O(n³) in the original) and validation reconstruction, each distributed across the GPUs. Row-major storage is mapped onto column-major cuBLAS by operating on transposed views. A small custom kernel adds the diagonal shift.\n- **OpenMP** handles the host-side pieces: the small diagonal-block factorization each step (with the thread count clamped to the rank's available cores — this mattered, see below), result assembly, upper-triangle zeroing, and the validation comparison.\n- **MPI communication:** the factored diagonal block is broadcast; the panel column is exchanged with a single `MPI_Allgatherv` per step (pinned host staging), while locally-owned panel blocks are assembled device-to-device without touching the host. Failure of positive-definiteness is detected on the owner, reported with the same message/element index as the original, and propagated to all ranks.\n\n**Semantics:** identical CLI, output format, and control flow; rank 0 prints exactly what the original printed. The random matrix uses the same sequential `rand_r` stream (regenerated identically on every rank, so the input is never broadcast). Results match the original to 14+ significant digits (the printed `Sum` is bit-identical at n=512 and n=1000); the FNV hash of the raw doubles necessarily differs since blocked/GPU summation orders differ, but self-validation (`-v`) passes at all tested sizes.\n\n**Correctness testing:** validated at n=100 (single block), 512, 1000 (odd size, 3 ranks), 4096, 8192, 16384, with 1/2/3/4/5 ranks including more ranks than blocks; `-h` and unknown-option paths behave as before.\n\n**Performance** (n=16384, `--bind-to none`): 389 GFLOPS on 1 rank/GPU → 874 GFLOPS on 4 (a 3090's FP64 peak is only ~556 GFLOPS, so this is ~40% of aggregate peak, communication-bound at this size). One gotcha I fixed along the way: OpenMPI's default core binding for np ≤ 2 was strangling the host-side block factorization; clamping its OpenMP thread count to the affinity mask fixed that, though `mpirun --bind-to none` (or numa) is still the recommended launch.\n\n**CMakeLists:** the source is compiled as CUDA (it contains a kernel), linking `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, `CUDA::cudart`, `CUDA::cublas` — all part of the already-present toolchains, no new external dependencies. It selects g++-12 as the CUDA host compiler (CUDA 12.0 rejects the default g++-13) and defaults `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to `native`."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":571,"cache_read_input_tokens":87253,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":571},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f8c8273c-0b50-4ee1-9321-6117a4ef2c13","uuid":"2c0ee287-10cb-4110-b0f8-631c9a08538e","timestamp":"2026-09-02T20:55:04.498Z","request_id":"req_011CefH7GoLuD2CH9njDCLzU"}
